value.message: Enable SSO for a tenant. Note, currently SSO can be configured only for a single tenant.
Find your app in the Microsoft Teams admin center, and copy and paste the 'App ID' here.

Turn on link authentication for your Virtual Agent. Complete the two steps below to allow your users to access content using different link opening experience. Note: make sure your integration is available in the 'All Integrations' tab before proceeding.
This will take you to the 'Install Azure Apps' page where you can install your tenant and authorize it for SSO.
